description: Sensitivity trial with 10 ks of strong left conditioning, 10 ks of strong right reversal cue and a 1-ks cue-free persistence check.

metadata.scoring_note: The strong-reversal latency field is latency after cue switch; the reverse cue remains present until 20000 s.
